reason: Single fusiform hyperintense mass in the lateral thigh (k~106-196, ~34 mL). Outline matches the bright mass and its grey rim in axial, coronal and sagittal reviews, and no lesion tissue shows in the past-the-mask panels. Candidates C1, C2, C4, C5 are skin/fat/marker or noise and C3 is a surrounding grey halo, so none were accepted. Remaining uncertainty: whether the thin tapering tails at each end and the faint medial halo belong to the tumour.
